content.value_statement: Adding core business logic can drift from project conventions. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a focused checklist for Catalyst-Relay core functions.
actual_capabilities: Identifies the expected file path for one Catalyst-Relay core function per file.
Explains the import hierarchy for types, helpers, subfolder files, and barrel exports.
Provides a TypeScript function pattern using AdtRequestor and AsyncResult.
Documents the Go-style error tuple return convention used by the project.
Shows when to export public functions from index.ts and keep helpers internal.
Supplies a checklist for creating and verifying a new core function.
limitations: It is specific to Catalyst-Relay conventions and may not fit other TypeScript projects.
It does not define domain-specific business rules for a new function.
It does not replace tests, type checking, or reviewer approval.
It assumes the existing project structure and shared types already exist.

use_cases.title: Add an ADT Operation
use_cases.description: Create a new ADT read, create, discovery, or preview function using the project structure.

use_cases.title: Standardize Core Logic
use_cases.description: Align new business logic with existing imports, result tuples, helper placement, and exports.

use_cases.title: Review Function Placement
use_cases.description: Check whether a proposed function, helper, or type belongs in a subfolder, helpers file, or barrel export.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Function
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single new core function.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a new Catalyst-Relay core function for [operation]. Follow the one-function-per-file layout and use the project result convention.

prompt_templates.title: Plan File Placement
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan where [function name] should live in src/core. Include needed imports, helper placement, and whether it should be exported.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor to Convention
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Catalyst-Relay core function and adjust it to match the documented import hierarchy, AsyncResult return style, and barrel export rules.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Core API Addition
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a full library addition.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design and implement a new [domain] core API function. Include types, internal helpers, public exports, error tuple handling, and verification steps.

output_examples.input: Add a discovery function for package metadata.
output_examples.output: A new function plan with the target discovery file, required requestor type, result tuple behavior, parser helper guidance, and export reminder.

output_examples.input: Review whether a helper should be public.
output_examples.output: A placement decision explaining whether the helper belongs in helpers.ts, a function file, or the public barrel export.

output_examples.input: Prepare a checklist for a new ADT create operation.
output_examples.output: A concise checklist covering file creation, local types, import hierarchy, AsyncResult handling, public exports, and type checking.

best_practices: Keep each core function in its own file with focused responsibility.
Use shared types and helpers through the documented import hierarchy.
Export only public API functions from the barrel file.
anti_patterns: Do not place several unrelated core functions in one file.
Do not create circular imports between helpers, types, and subfolder functions.
Do not export internal helpers as public API without a clear need.

faq.question: What project is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is for Catalyst-Relay and its TypeScript core business logic conventions.

faq.question: Does it create user interface code?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on core functions, ADT operations, shared types, helpers, and library exports.

faq.question: Does it require Claude Code?
faq.answer: No. The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it decide business rules?
faq.answer: No. You still need to provide the operation behavior, inputs, and expected domain result.

faq.question: Does it include testing instructions?
faq.answer: It includes a typecheck reminder, but it does not define a full test strategy.

faq.question: Why does it mention barrel exports?
faq.answer: The project exposes public core APIs through index.ts, while internal helpers stay private.
